objective: Obtener en solo lectura el conjunto exacto de EmpresaID derivables para david.ricardez@cienfuegos.mx usando el contrato canonico servidor/sucursal/unidad, como expected set del canary funcional posterior a R4.

queries.name: david_effective_company_expected_set
queries.sql: WITH TargetUser AS (SELECT UsuarioID FROM dbo.Usuario_Catalogo WHERE Email='david.ricardez@cienfuegos.mx' AND ISNULL(Activo,1)=1), UnitBase AS (SELECT TRY_CONVERT(uniqueidentifier,u.server_id) AS ServidorID,NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(CONVERT(nvarchar(100),u.sucursal_origen_id))), '') AS SucursalOrigenID,COUNT_BIG(*) OVER(PARTITION BY u.server_id) AS ActiveUnitsOnServer FROM dbo.Unidades_Negocio u WHERE ISNULL(u.activo,0)=1), ActiveUnits AS (SELECT ub.ServidorID,ub.SucursalOrigenID,ub.ActiveUnitsOnServer,s.EmpresaID AS ServerEmpresaID,ss.EmpresaID AS BranchEmpresaID FROM UnitBase ub INNER JOIN dbo.Servidores_Conexiones s ON s.id=ub.ServidorID AND ISNULL(s.activo,1)=1 LEFT JOIN dbo.Sistema_SucursalServidorMapeo sm ON sm.ServidorID=s.id AND ISNULL(sm.Activo,1)=1 AND ub.SucursalOrigenID IS NOT NULL AND UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(sm.SucursalOrigenID,''))))=UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ub.SucursalOrigenID))) LEFT JOIN dbo.Sistema_Sucursales ss ON ss.SucursalID=sm.SucursalID AND ISNULL(ss.Activo,1)=1), ExplicitScope AS (SELECT usa.UsuarioID,usa.ServidorID,CAST(NULL AS nvarchar(100)) AS SucursalCodigo,CAST('SERVER' AS varchar(10)) AS ScopeType FROM dbo.Usuario_ServidoresAsignacion usa INNER JOIN TargetUser t ON t.UsuarioID=usa.UsuarioID WHERE ISNULL(usa.Activo,1)=1 UNION ALL SELECT usa.UsuarioID,usa.ServidorID,NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(CONVERT(nvarchar(100),usa.SucursalCodigo))), '') AS SucursalCodigo,CAST('BRANCH' AS varchar(10)) AS ScopeType FROM dbo.Usuario_SucursalesAsignacion usa INNER JOIN TargetUser t ON t.UsuarioID=usa.UsuarioID WHERE ISNULL(usa.Activo,1)=1), Derived AS (SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN au.ActiveUnitsOnServer>1 THEN au.BranchEmpresaID ELSE COALESCE(au.BranchEmpresaID,au.ServerEmpresaID) END AS EmpresaID FROM ExplicitScope es INNER JOIN ActiveUnits au ON au.ServidorID=es.ServidorID AND (au.ActiveUnitsOnServer=1 OR (au.ActiveUnitsOnServer>1 AND es.ScopeType='BRANCH' AND au.SucursalOrigenID IS NOT NULL AND es.SucursalCodigo IS NOT NULL AND UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(au.SucursalOrigenID)))=UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(es.SucursalCodigo)))))) SELECT d.EmpresaID,e.CodigoEmpresa,e.NombreEmpresa FROM Derived d LEFT JOIN dbo.Sistema_Empresas e ON e.EmpresaID=d.EmpresaID WHERE d.EmpresaID IS NOT NULL ORDER BY d.EmpresaID
